browser_failure.test: tests/e2e/api-web/alerts.spec.ts::inspects an actual captured event and separately acknowledges and resolves it
browser_failure.assertion: All non-checkbox form controls have height at least 44 CSS pixels.
browser_failure.visual_observation: The failure screenshot taken after the assertion shows the resolved revision and a correctly sized review textarea. It does not establish the DOM geometry at assertion time.

source_after_failure.change: Next development generated .next/dev/types imports instead of .next/types imports.

diagnosis.confirmed_test_gap: Backend durability and a disabled Resolve button did not establish that the refreshed event revision had committed; pending commands disable the same control.
diagnosis.diagnostic_follow_up: One isolated and five desktop cases passed with failure-detail instrumentation and unchanged assertions; these do not replace the failed gate.

correction.behavior: Require the exact acknowledged and resolved server revisions to be visible, and the review control to be enabled after each refreshed state, before advancing or measuring layout.
